dishes.name: Farci poitevin
dishes.desc: A slow-cooked pâté of greens and herbs such as sorrel, cabbage, chard and leeks, sometimes with bacon. Called a typical dish of Poitou, eaten cold or hot.

dishes.name: Chabichou du Poitou
dishes.desc: A whole-milk goat cheese with a distinctive truncated shape and a soft, creamy taste. Named the star cheese of the Vienne, with protected status.

dishes.name: Tourteau fromager
dishes.desc: A barely sweet goat-cheese cake with a dark, burnt crust. A Poitou tradition eaten as dessert, snack or with an aperitif.

dishes.name: Broyé du Poitou
dishes.desc: A hard, crumbly butter shortbread. Tradition says you break it by pressing the centre with your fist, and it is served at celebrations.

dishes.name: Montmorillon macaron
dishes.desc: Almond macarons from Montmorillon in the Vienne, made with egg whites and sugar. The town has been known for them for over two centuries.
